notes: Modular, fully-scalable I/O: up to 6 input cards x 4 inputs each (max 24 inputs) and up to 4 output cards x 4 outputs each (max 16 outputs); user populates only the cards needed (1-6 in, 1-4 out). Each input and each output physically provides all three connector types simultaneously (BNC/SDI, HDMI, DisplayPort) per the official installation manual's rear-panel diagram, not a single connector selectable by card variant. Grades (12G-SDI, HDMI 2.0, DisplayPort 1.2) are stated for all inputs/outputs per Christie's spec sheet/brochure. Power: 4 IEC-type AC receptacles per unit -- 2 active + 2 redundant (represented here as a single iec port entry with a note; exact IEC sub-type, C13/C14 vs C19, not stated in available docs, but Christie's standard rack gear of this era uses IEC C13/C14, and "standard AC power cords" are listed as accessories). Control card also exposes PCI-Express in/out (proprietary expansion, not in the connector list) and BNC Genlock/loop-out (bandwidth grade not applicable/not stated, omitted). Front-panel USB port is for firmware/manual access, not a general host/signal port, but included since it is a physical port on the device. RS-232 and Ethernet ports are confirmed in spec sheet but not individually diagrammed with connector sub-type in the manual excerpt reviewed; RS-232 assumed DE-9 (rs232 id) per industry-standard Christie practice, Ethernet is RJ45 10/100/1000 (eth-1g grade, as 1000BASE-T is the ceiling stated).
